spans.s:
उरी उरी, ind. (cf. उररी, ऊररी, ऊरी), a particle
implying (especially in composition with the roots
अस्, भू, and कृ) promise, assent, admission, ex-
tension, diffusion, &c.

ऊरी, ind. = ऊररी; see उरी.
—ऊरी-कृत्य, ind.
having promised, agreed, assented to.

उरी-कृ, to promise, allow, admit, assent.
—उरी-
कार, अस्, m. promise, admission, extension.
—उरी-
कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, promised, extended, spread.
